analysis: GENOA meQTL variant scoring on frozen SilentMethyl checkpoints
effect_allele_convention: Compare Predicted_Delta_M / Predicted_Delta_Beta against beta_genoa_ref_to_alt. Raw beta_genoa is keyed to the minor allele; the model delta is keyed to hg38 REF->ALT.
effect_scale_caveat: GENOA effect sizes are on a normalized-phenotype scale, not the beta or M scale the model predicts. Spearman rho, direction agreement and AUROC are meaningful; magnitude calibration against GENOA is not.
relabelled: tissue_caveat rewritten in place 16 Sep 2026: the original, hardcoded by scripts/20_variant_scoring.py, named MCF-10A context although these runs scored checkpoints_ablation/breast_epithelium/seed42/fusion/best_weights.pth against data/datafiles_breast_epithelium/{split}.csv. No number changed.
reporting_guidance: Report the heldout stratum as primary. Never pool the strata. Report CpG-creating/destroying variants separately from the rest.
tissue_caveat: The fusion model's context features are primary breast epithelium (ENCODE; ATAC-seq and six histone ChIP-seq tracks, fold change over control). For a cohort measured outside breast (GENOA: blood; non-breast eGTEx tissues) fusion results are cross-tissue transfer, not tissue-matched validation. The sequence-only model is tissue-agnostic and is the comparator that makes the fusion result interpretable.
